sprints.title: Care Plans, Clinical Tasks & Professional Messaging
sprints.note: Care Plans, Clinical Tasks and Professional Messaging are runtime-wired with PostgreSQL repositories and migration 020. Core mutations use UnitOfWork + transactional outbox; goal reviews and assignments now follow the same durability rule. Care Goal/Intervention creation is relationship-scoped at the service boundary. Care Plan review execution now uses an atomic intent claim plus a retry-safe saga with preallocated version IDs and transactional completion events. Recurrence, reminder dedupe, relationship-closure reconciliation, notifications, protected-content Safety forwarding and deny-by-default attachments are implemented. Remaining certification blockers: no approved Professional Messaging protected-content classifier is configured, and the GitHub repo still lacks the full Sprint 1–21 foundation needed for dependency-backed Sprint 1–22 regression, PostgreSQL migration/E2E/security/privacy/build certification.
